SYMPTOM: Clicking 'Hunt this down' made the search API call (200 OK), URL changed, but UI stayed on items page or reset back to home
CAUSE: A `useEffect` watching `searchParams` would fire whenever the URL changed and reset the phase to 'identified'. After Hunt triggered a navigation, the URL change caused the effect to run and reset the phase, undoing the `setPhase('results')` call.
FIX: Add a guard in the searchParams effect — only set phase if currently in 'upload' phase, never override 'results':
```ts
useEffect(() => {
  if (phase !== 'upload') return; // don't override results phase
  // rest of effect
}, [searchParams])
```
SECONDARY: When loading items from history (URL ?searchId=xxx), also set `setCurrentSearchId(searchId)` so image search UUIDs can be retrieved for that search
